Training eligibility, maximum ranks and price are separate. Disable Device and Open Lock can be trained only when at least one class already taken has that skill as a class skill. Ordinary Ranger 1 cannot train either; paying a cross-class price does not make it eligible. UMD and Tumble can be trained cross-class. During heroic training (levels 1–20), a skill that is cross-class for all classes taken has a maximum of (3 + character level) / 2 ranks; taking a class that has it raises the maximum to character level + 3. Rogue-first class and racial lives can train Disable Device and Open Lock at character level 1, with a maximum of 4 ranks. On Scourge, Rogue 1 is taken at character level 2: the Rogue class-skill ceiling is 5 then, 6 at level 3 and 23 at level 20. These are ceilings, not purchased ranks; each purchase still uses the class being advanced. Choosing iconic levels 1–15 in one sitting does not let a later Rogue level supply eligibility at the earlier Ranger-1 training step. Dated source-ledger evidence and limits.
